A standard charging/averaging argument (or induction on the number of pairs, peeling off triples that contribute at most 2 points per 3 pairs) shows that among any $m$ off‑diagonal pairs the student can always satisfy at least $\lceil 2m/3\rceil$.  With 68 pairs total this yields at least 45 points regardless of the configuration.

Thus 45 is the largest guaranteed score.
